Verses.1:
God of my ancestors and Lord of mercy,
	by Your Word You made all things.
Verses.2:
In Your wisdom, Your Word formed humankind
	to rule over the creatures You have made.
Verses.3:
Your Word governs the world in holiness and righteousness,
	and, from your uprightness, You render your judgement.
Verses.4:
Give me the Wisdom that sits beside Your throne.
	Do not cast me out from among Your children.
Verses.5:
I am your servant, the child of Your female servant.
	I am one who is weak and short-lived
	who is lacking in understand of judgement and laws.
Verses.6:
For anyone who is perfect among mortals
	will be regarded as nothing
	without the Wisdom that comes from You.
Verses.7:
You have chosen me to be king over Your people
	and to be the judge over Your children.
Verses.8:
You have spoken that a temple be built on Your holy mountain
	and an alter in the city where You dwell.
It shall be a copy of the holy tabernacle
	You had established from the beginning.
Verses.9:
Now with You is Wisdom. She who knows Your works
	and was with You when You made the cosmos.
She understands what is pleasing in Your eyes
	and what is right according to Your commands.
Verses.10:
Send Her from Your most Holy heavens.
	From Your glorious throne, send Her.
Let Her work with me, by my side,
	that She may teach me what is pleasing to You.
Verses.11:
For She knows and understands all things,
	Her wisdom will guide my actions,
	and in Her glory, She will keep me.
Verses.12:
Then my works will be acceptable,
	and I shall judge Your people justly,
	and be worthy of my father's throne.
Verses.13:
What person can discover God's purpose?
	Who can understand the Lord's will?
Verses.14:
For the reasoning of mortals is worthless
	and unstable are our plans.
Verses.15:
The perishable body weighs down the soul,
	and this earthly corpse burdens the thoughtful mind.
Verses.16:
We can hardly imagine what is on the earth,
	and, with difficulty, we grasp what is at hand.
	Who then has discovered what is in heaven?
Verses.17:
Who would have known Your will,
	if You had not given your Wisdom
	and sent Your Holy Spirit from on high?
Verses.18:
And this is how the paths of those on earth were made straight,
	and people learned what pleases You,
	and, by Wisdom, they were saved.
